purpose: Preserve complete instruction ordering, typed operand value IDs and result value IDs without allocating a fixed in-memory instruction matrix sized to the host oracle.

logical_instruction.ordering_rule: functions in canonical function order; blocks in canonical block order; instructions in lexical/semantic order within each block
logical_instruction.operand_rule: every operand is a defined semantic value ID or an opcode-specific non-value auxiliary field
logical_instruction.result_rule: every materialized result owns exactly one semantic value ID whose defining_instruction_id equals instruction_id
logical_instruction.multiple_result_representation: count plus contiguous result-ID list; current bootstrap subset may use zero/one but schema must not encode that as a permanent invariant

physical_strategy.reason: The measured host IR is much larger than the current legacy 365-slot banks; arbitrary fixed expansion recreates the bootstrap memory failure mode.
physical_strategy.legacy_lane_rewrite_frontier: Only after all legacy information needed by the current scanner/verifier has been consumed and a new verifier proves exact instruction count, ordering, operand definitions and result definitions.
physical_strategy.storage_reuse: Existing write-only legacy instruction banks may be reclaimed only after the rewrite frontier is proven; their existing contents are not semantic instruction definitions.

verifier_requirements: instruction IDs are contiguous and strictly monotonic
every instruction references a valid owner block
ordinal_in_block is contiguous from zero for each block
all operand value IDs are defined before use except explicitly modeled control-flow phi-like semantics, which are not part of the current bootstrap subset
all result value IDs are unique definitions and agree with the value namespace type/owner contract
call instructions delegate call argument/result linkage to the call contract
terminator instructions delegate branch/jump/return completeness to the terminator contract
serialized instruction count equals the semantic instruction count with no truncation
prohibited_shortcuts: reinterpret aggregate event opcodes as complete semantic instructions
reinterpret legacy ir_instruction_records stores as def-use IR without reads/verifier
allocate an arbitrary fixed matrix sized from a historical partial audit
recover operands/results by rereading raw source in the general emitter
drop instruction ordering and reconstruct it later from aggregate counts
